name: How quickly do I need to address water damage in a rental property to prevent mold?

mainEntity.name: How quickly do I need to address water damage in a rental property to prevent mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water damage needs to be addressed very quickly to prevent mold growth, ideally within 24 to 48 hours. Mold can begin to grow on wet surfaces within this timeframe, leading to more extensive damage and potential health issues. Professional water damage restoration services can rapidly extract water, thoroughly dry affected areas, and apply antimicrobial treatments. Prompt action is crucial to mitigate mold risks and minimize the overall impact on the property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water damage should be addressed within 24-48 hours to prevent mold growth. Prompt professional mitigation is essential.
